candidates.summary: Deliver healthcare equipment projects from design to installation, ensuring quality, compliance, stakeholder alignment, and customer success.
candidates.opening:
Company description:
STERIS is a leading provider of infection prevention and procedural products and services, focused primarily on the critical markets of healthcare, pharmaceutical and research and medical devices. Our mission is to help our Customers create a healthier and safer world by providing innovative healthcare and life science product and service solutions around the globe. We have 12,000 employees worldwide, with over 3,000 in Customer-facing sales and service roles. Founded as Innovative Medical Technologies in Ohio in 1985, the company was renamed STERIS in 1987. Many of the businesses that have been acquired and integrated into STERIS have much longer operating histories, notably the American Sterilizer Company founded in 1894. The STERIS Vision is inspired by our Customers' efforts to create a healthier and safer world, and guided by our legacy of leadership and innovat
key_lines: As a Project Engineer, you will play a key role in delivering exceptional customer outcomes through the design, coordination, and end-to-end execution of capital medical equipment projects across the STERIS Healthcare portfolio throughout Australia and New Zealand. From initial project scoping and design development through to installation, commissioning, and project completion, you will ensure projects are delivered safely, on time, within budget, and in compliance with clinical and regulatory requirements.
* Define project scope, objectives, milestones, and deliverables aligned with customer and business requirements.
* Provide design, planning, and coordination of CSD, Endo and Surgical projects from pre-sales through to installation and project closeout.
* Develop equipment layouts, specifications, CAD & REVIT drawings, sizing reports, schedules, budgets, quotations, and technical proposals.
* Review project requirements, drawings, and specifications to ensure compliance with healthcare standards and best practices.
* Develop and maintain project plans, tracking scope, schedule, cost, quality, and resource requirements.
The Experience, Skills and Abilities Needed
Required:
* Bachelor's Degree in Engineering.
* Proficient in CAD and/or REVIT drafting packages.
* Demonstrated experience delivering complex projects, preferably within healthcare, medical devices, capital equipment, engineering, construction, or technical environments.
* Valid driver's licence and willingness to travel as required.
* Project Management experience.
* Experience working with healthcare facility projects, sterilisation departments, operating theatres, or medical capital equipment installations.
